raw_segments.text: Dogberry, moreover, sir, which indeed is not under white and black.
This plaintiff here, the offender, did call me ass.
I beseech you, let it be remembered in his punishment.
And also the watch heard them talk of one deformed.
They say he wears a key in his ear and a lock hanging by it, and borrows money in God's
name, the which he hath used so long and never paid, that now men grow hard-hearted, and
will lend nothing for God's sake.
Pray you examine him upon that point.
